question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He was put behind bars for his act of __forgery.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **counterfeiting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forgery **means the action of forging or producing a copy of a document, signature, banknote, or work of art with the intention to deceive. (कूट-रचना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The criminal was charged with forgery after attempting to pass off a fake signature on the legal document.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Counterfeiting **means the production of an imitation of currency, documents, or goods, with the intent to deceive and pass them off as genuine. (जालसाजी)
 
 
• **Example**: *The police seized a large quantity of counterfeit currency during the raid on the illegal printing operation.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Murdering**: The act of killing someone unlawfully and with premeditation. (हत्या)
 
• **Coaxing**: Persuading someone to do something by gentle urging or flattery. (मीठी बातें से मनाना)
 
• **Embezzling**: The act of dishonestly appropriating or misappropriating money or assets entrusted to one's care, typically by an employer or client. (गबन करना)
